root_cause: Two wiring faults, both mine, not PGV behaviour. (1) make api declared pgv as a prerequisite, so the scoped PGV ran BEFORE the default pass whose buf.gen.yaml carries clean=true; that clean wiped the freshly generated validators and left whatever other templates had written, which is where the '111 with 8 extra' and the two differing validators came from. (2) gow api correctly rejected the new buf.validate.gen.yaml as an unclassified template, so gow api aborted with exit 1 and produced nothing.
withdrawn_hypotheses: protoc-gen-validate generates for imported dependencies (case A trace: 15 shards, every FileToGenerate inside the approved 103, zero extras)
buf.aksk.gen.yaml's own pinned PGV entry over-generates (its seven input protos are all inside the 103; with that entry untouched a full gow api still yields 103 and zero unexpected)
the earlier '8 vs 9 stems' count: the extra files no longer appear at all once the ordering is fixed
